source: Native SNS Publish through real Python3.12 Lambda runtime to actual SQS receipts; no reconstructed events
scope: One uniquely owned standard SNS topic, Lambda subscription/function, execution role with only sqs:SendMessage on owned output queue. Invocation permission scoped to exact source topic and account. No CloudWatch logging permissions.

provenance.pattern: scripts/aws/logs_subscriptions_probe.py HANDLER and in-memory ZIP provisioning

redactions: Only STS caller Arn and UserId omitted. Native resource names, account, publication IDs, signatures, full receipt bodies and receipt handles retained. No raw CLI debug/signing logs or presigned code URLs stored.

limitations: One account/region and bounded observation; non-observation is not proof of permanent rejection or loss.
SNS Lambda invocation and handler SQS send are managed/runtime requests, not separately observed CLI requests; handler context request ID and output SQS ID correlate actual runtime delivery.
Filter updates can require up to 15 minutes to propagate; this probe records only its short window and makes no guaranteed non-delivery claim.
